name: KRAFTON Raon-1 mini preview
context_scaling: NoPE rather than a scaling scheme: config.json sets rope_parameters: null and mla_use_nope: true and max_position_embeddings 262144, so the 7 MLA layers carry no positional encoding and nothing is extended by scaling. The 18 Raon Delta Attention layers are recurrent with a gated forget/erase mechanism, which is where length generalisation comes from instead of RoPE. The card states 'NoPE (no positional encoding)' and 262,144 native tokens and does not claim a window beyond that, so context_scaling_method is recorded as 'other' (NoPE/recurrent, none of the schema's scaling enum values apply).
attention_variant: Hybrid RDA 3:1 Gated MLA. 18 of 25 layers are Raon Delta Attention (linear attention, fixed-size state, decoupled erase/write gates over Kimi Delta Attention) and 7 are gated MLA at rda_config.mla_layers [4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 25]. Only those 7 hold a per-token KV cache. Raon-mHC with 4 residual streams.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-22 from the HF API trending feed. A trained-from-scratch 30B-A4B Korean/English MoE from KRAFTON AI, not a derivative of any catalog base, so it is a first-class base record. Repo created 2026-10-21, and the card states this is a PREVIEW: 'not a final model. Specs and results may change' - confidence held at 0.6 for that reason. GATED: the repo carries extra_gated_fields and config.json returns 401 without auth, yet the card, the config and the safetensors metadata were all readable through the API on 2026-10-22, which is where these numbers come from. Licence tag is apache-2.0 and the card says 'open-weight model, access granted on request'. PARAMS: HF safetensors total 28,783,218,402, split BF16 3.11e9 / F8_E4M3 25.67e9 - the repo ships MXFP8 (quantization_config quant_method mxfp8 with lm_head, attention and MLP projections in ignored_layers). params_b = 28.783. active_params_b is the card's 4.3B, not a count derived here; the card breaks it down as 6 of 128 routed experts plus 1 shared expert at intermediate 1,088. flops_per_token_active = 3 x 4.3e9 = 12.9e9 following the 3x-multiply-and-add convention used by the other MoE records; a 2N one-pass estimate would be 8.6e9. KV: the card says the 7 MLA layers keep 'about 8 KiB per token in BF16'. Derived independently: 7 x (512 kv_lora_rank + 64 qk_rope_head_dim) x 2 bytes = 8,064 B = 7.875 KiB, which confirms the card. The 18 RDA layers have a fixed-size state and add nothing per token, so 8,064 B is the whole per-token cache - this is what makes 262k context cheap on a small card. CLASS WINS (same test; catalog class = params_b<=60 and active<=5.5B, n=107 records): IFBench 84.2 vs the previous class best spark-x2-6-4b 75.8, and above motif-3 78.2 despite motif-3 being 314B total. AIME 2026 93.3 vs spark-x2-6-4b 91.2. LOSES that same class on MMLU Pro (76.5 vs nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning 81.94), GPQA Diamond (84.3 vs ornith-1-5-35b-a3b 89.2), SWE-bench Verified (70.8 vs ornith 79.0), LiveCodeBench v6 (81.6 vs mellum2-1-12b-a2-5b 82.0) and Terminal-Bench Lite (47.0, last of five in its own table). Qwen3.8-27B beats it on 11 of the 18 rows in its own table. NOT CROSS-CHECKED against a second source: every number is the vendor's, marked vendor_claim. Footnotes as printed: SWE-Verified uses mini-SWE-agent; GDPVal is a judge score not Elo; AutomationBench is the public split not the official set; the Korean chatbot row is an internal unreleased benchmark. HARDWARE GATE PASSED: 4.3B active with only 6 of 128 experts routed, so routed experts can sit in system RAM while the active path stays small - the offload shape this catalog ranks for. The card says an NVFP4 build runs on a single RTX 5090 32 GB.
kv_compression: MLA on the 7 attention layers: kv_lora_rank 512 plus qk_rope_head_dim 64 = 576 values per layer per token (latent plus decoupled rope key), not per-head K and V
